summary.text: Janis Holt is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 18 since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a business owner, rancher and former school teacher.

paragraphs.text: Janis Holt was born in Silsbee, Texas, graduated from Port Neches Groves High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Lamar University in 1994.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including work as an air purification business owner and educator.
Holt succeeded Ernest Bailes in the Texas House, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has been a resident of House District 18 for more than 30 years.
She listed securing the border, protecting the unborn, and protecting Texas land as her three key campaign messages and named homeland security as a policy area she is passionate about.
